author.attribution_scope: Reused deterministic extraction script, run by the current conversation as requested by the user. No model API or subagent called by this script.

supported_templates.regex: ^(?<title>.+?)(?:岗位职责|职位要求)_(?<company>.+?)\k<title>(?:任职要求|岗位要求|工作职责|职位要求)-智通直聘$

policies.missing_fields: Null values carry independent unknown reasons. Query target is never employer proof.
policies.optional_fields: Only explicit labels in metadata after one exact primary-title H1 and before the next section. Multiple salary mentions or job contexts cannot supply salary. Title location stays location_raw, not inferred city.
policies.duplicates: No normalization, alias, company, title or HR merging. Exact URL group never erases its result IDs; jobs.json source_url is not a job_url.
policies.raw_integrity: All raw search bytes and decoded result SHA checked against index; every segment and populated field is bound by exact offsets and SHA.
policies.rejected: Retained unchanged in search-index.json; audit accounts for every original result_id.
policies.rebuild: node search-job-leads.mjs; --self-test checks without writes; optional --parent-accepted-agent-id records the parent-supplied dispatch ID without billing confirmation.
